properties.name: Cooum River, Kesavaram anicut to the sea
properties.note: Hand-traced through geocoded towns and bridges, about 62 km here (official length about 65 km). Follows the real course only roughly; trace from OpenStreetMap before engineering use.

properties.name: Official restoration stretch: Paruthipattu to the mouth (32 km)
properties.note: Extent is from CRRT; the line uses the approximate trace.

properties.name: Pilot stretch 1: Napier Bridge to river mouth (0.5 km)
properties.note: End points from the DPR tender news; line drawn on the approximate trace.

properties.name: Pilot stretch 2: Periyar Bridge to Swami Sivananda Salai (1.2 km)
properties.note: Named in the DPR tender; where Sivananda Salai meets the river is estimated (1.2 km below Periyar Bridge).

properties.name: Pilot stretch 3: Link Road to Dams Road (2 km)
properties.note: Named in the DPR tender; Dams Road end placed at the Anna Salai bridge, Link Road end estimated 2 km upstream.

properties.name: Kesavaram anicut (source of the Cooum)
properties.note: Mapbox lists this as 'Pudu Kesavaram Dam', Arakkonam. Taken as the anicut where the Cooum leaves the Kosasthalaiyar; confirm on site.

properties.name: Napier Bridge
properties.note: Bridge position from Mapbox.

properties.name: Periyar Bridge
properties.note: Bridge position from Mapbox.

properties.name: Anna Salai (Mount Road) bridge, Dams Road
properties.note: Bridge position from Mapbox.

properties.name: River mouth at Marina (sand bar forms here)
properties.note: Mouth closes with sand most of the year; dredged repeatedly.

properties.name: Koyambedu treatment plant: 45 MLD tertiary (TTRO) water
properties.note: Less than 20 MLD of 45 MLD is used today. Releasing spare water as year-round base flow (~580 mcft a year) keeps the river moving and the mouth open. Plant pin from Mapbox.

properties.name: Proposed treated-water outfall to river
properties.note: Short release pipe; route not surveyed.

properties.name: Pudumavilangai check dam (existing)
properties.note: 2.3 m high, 100 m wide, ₹7.8 cr; irrigates Kadambathur, Satharai, Agaram. Position estimated near the named village. Proposal: add adjustable shutters (₹0.5 to 1.5 cr each, +30 to 50% storage).

properties.name: Putlur check dam (existing)
properties.note: One of five existing dams that held at least 130 mcft after a good monsoon. Position estimated near the named village. Proposal: add adjustable shutters (₹0.5 to 1.5 cr each, +30 to 50% storage).

properties.name: Paruthipattu check dam (existing)
properties.note: Upstream end of the 32 km restoration stretch. Position estimated near the named village. Proposal: add adjustable shutters (₹0.5 to 1.5 cr each, +30 to 50% storage).

properties.name: Soranjeri check dam (sanctioned 2022, ₹5.62 cr)
properties.note: Sanctioned by WRD G.O. 12 (2022). Site position not public; placed on the river between Aranvoyal and Paruthipattu.

properties.name: New shuttered check dam (candidate)
properties.note: Candidate for 2 to 3 more shuttered dams in years 1 to 3, near farm tanks.

properties.name: New shuttered check dam (candidate)
properties.note: Candidate site, as above.

properties.name: Upper-zone irrigation tank cluster (~80 tanks, ~9,940 ha)
properties.note: 80 tanks with ~9,940 ha registered farmland in the sub-basin; 61 rural tanks irrigate ~6,630 ha in Kancheepuram, Thiruvallur and Vellore blocks. Outline is a rough zone, not individual tanks.

properties.name: North training wall (proposed, 265 m)
properties.note: WRD plan with NIOT design, about ₹70 cr for both walls. Needs CRZ clearance, ~18 months. Alignment drawn schematically.

properties.name: South training wall (proposed, 310 m)
properties.note: As above. Get the angle and height right: earlier Cooum walls failed.

properties.name: Boating weir candidate: Chetpet
properties.note: Inflatable rubber or gated weir, 1 to 1.5 m, ₹10 to 30 cr; lies flat in floods. Build only after clean base flow exists.
